source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The density and font-size containers each own a direct image and also contain toolbarbuttons. Their icon selectors use > .toolbarbutton-icon, so the container image receives the menu icon without applying that content to descendant controls. This is a specific markup/selector boundary, not a general CSS image API rule. The accepted review has no substantive inline rationale, and the suspected upstream regression remains unproved. No visual, keyboard or accessibility runtime test ran.
title: Target the AppMenu control image without changing nested button icons
